source_units.text: I am observing a canine scent-work class and want to understand its training terms.
Keep the timetable within the window ending 2027-02-07, with the end date included.

My daily study allowance is 50 minutes maximum, not 50 minutes per topic.
I specifically require a minimum of 40 minutes altogether on "Indication Cues".
